verdict.rationale: SerpApi's pricing page documents plan quotas, such as the Free plan at 250 searches per month. Cached searches don't count toward the monthly quota, and paid tiers (e.g. Production Plan and above) exist, with an Automatic Early Renewal option when searches run out. That covers usage limits and suggests self-serve plan management. missing for 10: documented per-second or per-hour rate limits, documented concurrency caps, an explicit self-serve upgrade flow, and independent corroboration.
